Per the platform runbook, the service was rolled back in all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. args.title: checkout-api rollback to v2.3.0 after unhealthy v2.3.1 deploy

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: `checkout-api` v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
2. **Rolled back**: Deployed v2.3.0 — the most recent release that was healthy in production — to all production regions. The rollback completed and was verified; all regions now run v2.3.0.
3. **Opened incident**: Created **INC-0001** (SEV2) for checkout-api, describing the failed v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback to v2.3.0, and its verified completion. The on-call engineer has been paged.

Note: v2.3.1 will need investigation before it's redeployed — re-deploying an unhealthy version may require change-manager approval.
